title: Design System: Pristine Dryer Vents LLC

display.purpose: Hero H1 only; bounces in letter by letter.

numeral.purpose: The price figure; the closing phone number is its sibling at clamp(30px,9vw,52px).

title.purpose: Claim rows, step titles, card headings.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, header phone number.

body.purpose: Default running text, inputs, chips, footer.

shadows.name: hero-logo-lift
shadows.purpose: Logo card in the desktop hero column only.

motion.name: letter-in
motion.value: 1s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), stagger 20ms per letter, from opacity 0 + translateX(50px)
motion.purpose: Hero H1 bounce-in; off when CONFIG.MOTION is false or reduced motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity/transform .4s ease-out from translateY(12px); claims stagger 40ms
motion.purpose: One fade-up for elements that start below the first screen; visible at rest.

config.name: FLOAT
config.effect: false removes the floating text circle

config.name: MOTION
config.effect: false disables the H1 bounce-in and the fade-up (older-audience build)

config.name: PHONE
config.effect: number the booking form composes its sms: to; static tel:/sms: links must match

components.name: Floating Text Circle
components.description: 60px vent-blue circle that opens sms:; slides in after the hero (CONFIG.FLOAT).

narrative.overview:
A one-page, phone-first site built from full-width horizontal bands that alternate between off-white paper, Pristine navy, and a deep navy carrying faint diagonal lines. Every band holds one idea in big, friendly Cal Sans and short system-font copy, so the page reads like a neighbor explaining things plainly, one screen at a time. The single loud colour is the logo's vent blue, and it is spent on things you tap (buttons, the step markers, the floating text circle) and on the last phrase of a few headings. It is not used for decoration.

Density is low and type is large: body copy sits at 16/1.7, ledes at 18 to 19px, and every touch target is at least 44px tall, because many visitors are older homeowners arriving from Facebook on a phone. The world has no photography (the business has no job photos), so the hero is a plain textured navy band. The logo artwork sits on its own matte card, in the hero's right column on desktop and under the owners' intro on phones.

Motion is restrained and switchable: the hero H1 bounces in letter by letter once, content below the fold rises 12px as it enters, and a floating text circle slides up once the hero has gone. All three respect `prefers-reduced-motion`, and `CONFIG.MOTION = false` turns the first two off for an older-audience build.
keyCharacteristics: Three band grounds (paper, navy, deep navy with lines); no gradients, no photos.
One accent, the vent blue, used as a fill. Text on it is always ink.
Cal Sans at weight 400 for every display role, including buttons, labels, prices and the phone number.
Fully round pill buttons and chips, 24px cards, 10px fields.
Flat surfaces. The only shadows are on things that float.
Booking is a text message: every primary action ends in `sms:` or `tel:`.

rules.name: The Fill-Only Blue Rule
rules.body: Vent blue is a fill. Text and icons on it are always ink. When blue has to be text on a light ground it becomes blue ink. On navy it may be text only at display sizes (24px and up), because it reaches 4.2:1 there and needs large text to pass.

rules.name: The Three Bands Rule
rules.body: A section sits on paper, navy, or deep navy. The diagonal line texture (`repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 22px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px)`) goes only on the hero and the deep-navy bands. Plain navy bands (price, close) stay untextured.

rules.name: The Navy Focus Rule
rules.body: On light grounds, focus and hover outlines are Pristine navy, so they never look like the blue fill. On navy and deep grounds the outline switches to vent blue. On the blue float circle it is white.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Cal Sans is only ever set at 400. Hierarchy comes from size alone. Don't fake-bold it, and don't use it for running text.

rules.name: The Accent Phrase Rule
rules.body: Some headings end with a phrase in the accent colour: vent blue on dark bands, blue ink on paper. Examples are "Ocean County, NJ.", "per dryer.", "Daniel & Brandi.", "works." and "no fire." Use it on a minority of headings, never all of them. (The house style says dark bands only. The build also uses it once on paper, in blue ink, and this file records the build.)

rules.name: The Hero-Only Bounce Rule
rules.body: Only the hero H1 animates letter by letter. No other heading moves except through the shared fade-up.

rules.name: The Flat Bands Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, chips and inputs have no shadow, at rest or on hover. A shadow means the object floats over the page, and only the text circle and the hero logo do that.

dos: **Do** use vent blue only as a fill for actions and markers, with ink text on it (6.3:1).
**Do** switch blue to blue ink whenever it is text or an icon on paper or white.
**Do** keep Cal Sans at 400 and let size carry the hierarchy (84, 48, 24, 18px steps).
**Do** keep every touch target at least 44px, buttons at 56px, chips at 48px, and inputs at 52px.
**Do** put hover styles inside `@media (hover:hover)` so taps don't leave them stuck on.
**Do** keep content visible at rest. Motion only reveals what starts below the first screen.
**Do** route every booking action to `sms:` or `tel:` on the one published number.
donts: **Don't** set vent blue as text on paper (2.6:1) or white text on vent blue (2.9:1).
**Don't** use vent blue as body-size text on navy. At 4.2:1 it is for display-size accents only.
**Don't** add shadows to cards, buttons, chips or inputs. Shadows are for the float circle and the hero logo.
**Don't** put the line texture on paper or on the plain navy price and closing bands.
**Don't** animate any heading but the hero H1, or add motion beyond the 12px fade-up.
**Don't** replace the float circle with a sticky bottom bar, or add a second floating action.
**Don't** add a Call button to the hero. The number lives in the header's top right and in the closing band.
